Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the conflicting release date data for "Niyoti". In Step 2, the WebSurfer provided clear evidence that Niyoti had an India-wide release on June 10, 2016, and a worldwide/official release on June 24, 2016. However, in Step 3, the Planner arbitrarily selected the later date (June 24) as the "primary-country official date" for Niyoti, ignoring the earlier June 10 date which was explicitly cited as the release date in West Bengal (India). This led to an incorrect comparison where Angali Pangali (June 17) was deemed earlier than Niyoti (June 24), whereas Niyoti actually came out earlier than Angali Pangali if the June 10 date is considered. The error stems from a failure to consistently apply the "earliest widely recognized release date" criteria established in the initial instructions, instead shifting the basis of comparison to a later date without justification.
